_about: Public-domain Thomas Rawson Birks (1810-1883), Knightbridge professor of moral philosophy at Cambridge and evangelical writer on prophecy and evidences, for the Word Hoard: Village Discourses, The Two Later Visions of Daniel, the Memoir of Edward Bickersteth, Horae Evangelicae, Modern Popery, Outlines of Unfulfilled Prophecy, The Difficulties of Belief, The Bible and Modern Thought, On Matter and Ether, The Exodus of Israel, The Ways of God, The Victory of Divine Goodness, Church and State, The Pentateuch and its Anatomists, The Scripture Doctrine of Creation, First Principles of Moral Science, Modern Utilitarianism, The Uncertainties of Modern Physical Science, the Right Estimation of Manuscript Evidence, a Commentary on Isaiah, Supernatural Revelation, Thoughts on the Times and Seasons of Sacred Prophecy, and Modern Physical Fatalism. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 118 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
